ALL THAT CERTAIN lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and  
improvements thereon, erected, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP of CHERRY HILL,  
County of CAMDEN, State of NEW JERSEY.

BEGINNING at a point in the Northwesterly line of Brace Road, New Jersey State  
Highway, Route 41 (100 feet wide) distant 203.57 feet Northeastwardly from the Northerly  
corner of Brace Road and Kresson Road (49.5 feet wide); thence

(1) Northeastwardly along the Northwesterly line of Brace Road, 400 feet to a point in the  
division line between Lots 6 and 8, Plan of East Haddonfield Extension; thence

(2) Northwestwardly along said division line and the division line between Lots 5 and 7, said  
plan, forming an interior angle of 86 degrees 08 minutes 20 seconds with Brace Road, 399.43  
feet to the former center line of New York Avenue, (30 feet wide, vacated 4-27-70 by Ordinance  
No. 70-11); thence

(3) Southwestwardly along the former Southeasterly line of New York Avenue forming an  
interior angle of 93 degrees 51 minutes 40 seconds with the last course 603.57 feet to the  
Northeasterly line of Kresson Road; thence

(4) Southeastwardly along the Northeasterly line of Kresson Road, forming an interior angle  
of 86 degrees 08 minutes 20 seconds with the last course, 35.03 feet to a point; thence

(5) Northeastwardly forming an interior angle of 93 degrees 51 minutes 40 seconds with  
Kresson Road 203.57 feet to a point; thence

(6) Southeastwardly forming an interior angle of 266 degrees 08 minutes 20 seconds with the  
last course 364.40 feet to the place of beginning.

BEING part of Lots 5, 6, 7 and 8, Plan of East Haddonfield Extension.

BEING Lot 7, Block 407 on the Tax Map of Cherry Hill Township.
